*   Input: A ship specification section (Section ID: 1, Title: GENERAL, Text: "1 GENERAL").
    *   Task: Extract explicit, checkable claims.
    *   Output Format: A single valid, parseable JSON array (or object containing an array) following a specific schema.
    *   Constraints:
        *   No inference.
        *   No unit conversion.
        *   Verbatim quotes.
        *   Return empty list if no claims.
        *   No Markdown fences.
        *   No extra text.
        *   JSON schema provided.

    *   Section ID: 1
    *   Title: GENERAL
    *   Text: "1 GENERAL"

    *   "1 GENERAL" contains no measurements, quantities, values, or checkable specifications. It is just a header/title.

    *   Since no claims are found, the `claims` array should be empty.
